When the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key ON, the side lights and/or number plate lights do not work.

Numerous faults, remote control not working, the buzzer cannot be heard, with the key on, Air Bag failure signal, rearscreen wiper on, side lights on and, especially, the engine does not start, could be caused by a break in the steering column switch unit positive supply fuse.
